claim_one_line: L131 -- IS A7 DISCHARGE-ABLE? NO: A7 IS LOAD-BEARING, and the answer was already banked in section 5 of the SAME DOCUMENT whose section 4 B949 was reading when it registered the lead. No preregistration, deliberately: the answer surfaced during the mandatory prior-art read BEFORE any computation, so sealing after seeing it would be worse than not sealing -- recorded as an open-and-shut reading, as B957 and B960 were. THE QUESTION: B949 paired UNIQUENESS_THEOREM's A7 statement ('not eliminable by any matrix-level axiom... the smallest piece of inserted structure in the whole construction') with B945's finding that the R<->L swap FIXES the object, reasoning that if A7's choice were that swap it would insert nothing. But section 5 of that document is titled 'The order choice is load-bearing (A7), not cosmetic' and already answers it. WHY B945 DOES NOT DISCHARGE A7, verified here: LR and RL ARE conjugate, via the record-swap P = [[0,1],[1,0]] (verified), so they share trace, determinant, eigenvalues and translation length -- the SAME CONJUGACY CLASS -- and B945's result that sigma fixes the cyclic word is exactly that CLASS-LEVEL statement. But the Mobius fixed-point polynomial is a BASED invariant, not a class invariant, and it DIFFERS across the three sectors: tau^2 - tau - 1 (roots phi, -1/phi), tau^2 + tau - 1 (roots 1/phi, -phi), and tau^2 - 3tau + 1 (roots phi^2, phi^-2). A7 lives at the BASED level, which is precisely where B945's observation is blind -- and B949 even flagged that risk ('B945 computes at word level, not in Isom(m004)'), so the flag was right and the document had already discharged the question. CONVENTION NOTE, HONESTLY: this bench's L/R naming is transposed relative to the document, so WHICH order carries the golden polynomial flips -- that is NOT a discrepancy but A DEMONSTRATION OF A7's CONTENT, since the assignment depends on a naming convention and that dependence IS the inserted bit. THE POSITIVE CONTENT, and it is the sharpest statement the programme has about the four letters: A7 ISOLATES, TO A SINGLE BINARY CHOICE, WHERE THE SPECIFIC NUMBER PHI -- rather than -phi or phi^2 -- ENTERS. So the four-letter principle plus six motivated axioms forces the object UP TO EXACTLY ONE BIT, and that bit is identifiable, named, and is the origin of phi. Stated precisely: A1-A7 imply A implies the entire proven core P1-P16, so the combination principle DOES force the structure; but A1-A6 are 'motivated but not laws of nature' by the document's own words and the unconditional direction (deriving the substrate from nothing) is MAPPED DEAD (B949); and the one residue is not vague -- it is ONE BIT, and it buys PHI. THE FOURTH INSTANCE: this is the fourth time today this seat declared open or absent something already banked -- B950 (Z6 'not addressed'; B862 derives it), B976 (hypercharge 'OPEN'; B864 derived it), B974 (the frame 'cannot be rebuilt'; B911 built it), and now B979 (A7 'possibly discharge-able'; section 5 of the same file says it is not). The most embarrassing of the four, because the answer was not in another arc or another seat's material but in the NEXT SECTION of the document being read -- and representation-sweep would NOT have caught it, since UNIQUENESS_THEOREM is not an arc.
